author: Jumb_
body:
Application
Age:13
Timezone:GMT+1(Spain)
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No 
Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No
CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers?
Nope
What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating?
Ive never moderated any server.
What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?
Im active in avicus, som days over 5 or 6 hours.
How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?
How the staff team is currently inactive, I could help with that.
What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?
A leader should have enough time for doing all the stuff a good leader must do, also should take into account other´s people opinión.
I don´t consider a leader because I dont like being one.
What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?
1:I talk the most talked lenguages in aviucs(spanish and english).
2:Im really active.
3;Im very strict with the rules.
What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?
-Hear others people opinion.(I love hearing different opinions)
-Treat all the people with respect(ofc I do that)
How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? 
1/2 hours per day.
CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?
Contact any other staff member while I freeze him so he cant play.

Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?
Contact staff so they can join to the cannel with another name so the guy doesnt realice he/she is from the staff team.

A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?
If its a ban for hacking, I guess I would have to unban him and ask any person who can record him and ban him with evidence.
If its a ban for spamming/unrespectfulness I would have to unban him.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?
I would take screenshot and contact any other staff member.

One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circunstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?
I would talk with them and see if we can agree with any other good idea.

CRITERIA 3: OTHER
NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.


What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?
I would be really happy because this is one of the 2 servers I play and I would like contribute more in it.

How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?
I always liked games such as DTM or CTW or those ones, and this server is nice on doing those games fun so thats something I like a
lot of it and that also makes it one of the two servers I currentle play on.

Do you speak any other languages than English?
Spanish and learning french.

Do you have anything else to add to your application?
-https://es.namemc.com/name/PatataArmada
-Im going to creat an yt cannel soon in which Ill upload some games if have recorded of avicus while I had the trial versión of action(game/screen recorder).
